psychological_meaning: Antique Brass evokes feelings of history, tradition, and understated elegance. It suggests a sense of timelessness and stability, often associated with sophistication and refinement. The color inspires a feeling of warmth and familiarity, reminiscent of classic and enduring aesthetics.
